description: This file contains functions and script logic for upgrading firmware and modifying boot configuration on Sony devices within an OpenWrt environment. It includes functions to update boot configuration partitions, perform eMMC upgrades, and flash kernel and root filesystem images from a tar archive.

methods.name: update_bootconfig
methods.description: Updates the boot configuration partition at a specified offset with a given index, and also updates an additional partition if present.

methods.name: sony_emmc_do_upgrade
methods.description: Performs a firmware upgrade by flashing kernel and root filesystem images, updating boot configurations, formatting the rootfs_data partition, and optionally restoring configuration backups.
